tr.title: Bu çalışmıyor
tr.subtitle: Destek kutusu · 16:48
tr.body:
Bir kullanıcı herkesin göreceği yere yazmış: *"Söz verdiğiniz şey çalışmıyor."*

Altına başkaları da ekleniyor. Cevap vermemek de bir cevap. Yanlış olanı.

en.title: This does not work
en.subtitle: Support inbox · 16:48
en.body:
A user has posted it where everyone can see: *"The thing you promised does not work."*

Others are piling in underneath. Not answering is an answer too. The wrong one.

options.explain: Reply in private, close the thread

_repair_note: the "ignore" row rendered a "customer lost" chip and on the B2C branch lost no customer at all. The effect describes what the prose says; the CHIP was the lie, and chips are built from effects in the new engine, so it closes itself
_r8a_note: A non-critical interrupt is demotable (§13.2), and a demoted card lands on the desk with a clock — which is the only reason paper is a safe floor for I4. So it carries the paper trio even though it usually renders as an interrupt.
_port_note: SCOPE ADDED. Every customer-scoped effect on this card resolved to NOTHING: the old executor's default target was `get_lowest_satisfaction_customer(<event's market>)`, computed at apply time, and the port carried the effects across without carrying the default. A required slot says the same thing in the vocabulary that can also refuse the card when there is nobody to be about — which the old default could not do; it silently no-opped and the player watched a decision change nothing.
